# Tests

- Fake a driver by subclassing `SocialDriver` by hand (`MockDriver` in `test/facades/social_auth_test.dart`): `dev_dependencies` carry no mocking library.
- Fake the platform through the `@visibleForTesting` seams (`SocialFlow.authenticate`, `GoogleDriver.nativeSignIn`, `GoogleDriver.initializeSdk`, `AppleDriver.requestCredential`) and never mock a `MethodChannel`, so no test depends on a plugin's channel names.
- `test/flow/social_flow_loopback_test.dart` never calls `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()`: the test binding installs an `HttpOverrides` whose client answers every request 400, which breaks a real-socket test. Keep any new loopback test out of that binding.
